1962-five-color-map.zh: 一张地图五种颜色，画的是势力范围，量的是人心向背。六十多年过去，颜色换了好几轮，倒是“用颜色给世界分类”这个习惯，一直没过时。
1962-five-color-map.en: Five colors on one map: spheres of influence measured in shades. Sixty years on, the colors have been repainted several times — but the habit of sorting the world by color never went out of style.

2001-land-green-smoke.zh: 这篇文章我读了两遍。第一遍看的是照片，第二遍看的是那句“有分别的是我”。有些文章读完想评论点什么，这篇读完，只想安静一会儿。
2001-land-green-smoke.en: I read this one twice. The first time for the photograph, the second time for one line: 'the difference is in me.' Some articles make you want to comment. This one makes you want to sit quietly for a while.

5-30-am-child.zh: 凌晨五点半起床的孩子，长大后多半还是凌晨五点半起床的大人，只是闹钟从妈妈变成了房贷。这篇文章最扎心的地方在于：它说的不是某个家庭，是排队买学区房的每一个人。
5-30-am-child.en: Kids who get up at 5:30 a.m. mostly grow into adults who get up at 5:30 a.m. — only the alarm changes, from mother to mortgage. The sharpest part of this piece: it is not about one family. It is about everyone in the school-district housing queue.

biden-promise-me-america.zh: 一本回忆录，写的是总统任期，最动人的却是那句“跌倒了，就爬起来”。政治人物写书通常是为了辩护，拜登这本更像在告别：答应我，美国，别忘了那个理念。
biden-promise-me-america.en: A presidential memoir, and the most moving line in it is 'champ, when you get knocked down, get up.' Politicians usually write books to defend themselves. This one reads more like a farewell: promise me, America, do not forget the idea.

big-tech-three-years.zh: 在大厂干三年，工资翻倍，体检异常 17 项——这买卖怎么算都像是用命换钱，还得分期付款。评论区比我热闹，往下翻，B 站网友的嘴比我毒多了。
big-tech-three-years.en: Three years at a big tech firm: salary doubled, 17 abnormal health indicators. However you do the math, that is paying for money with your life — in installments. The comment section below is livelier than me; Bilibili users are sharper-tongued than I am.

china-drinks-less.zh: 白酒销量跌了 74%，不是中国人喝不动了，是终于不用靠酒精谈生意、表忠心了。这一杯，敬不喝酒的自由。
china-drinks-less.en: Baijiu sales down 74% — not because China lost its capacity, but because business and loyalty no longer need to be proven at the bottom of a glass. This round is on the freedom not to drink.

china-nuclear-discharge-vs-fukushima.zh: 一边骂福岛排氚，一边自家四座核电站一年排出福岛六成的量。这篇文章把账本摊开的那一刻，煽动和遮掩就都站不住了。数据不站队，数据只打脸。
china-nuclear-discharge-vs-fukushima.en: Denouncing Fukushima's tritium while four domestic plants discharge 60% of that amount in a year — once this article lays the ledger on the table, neither the outrage nor the cover-up can stand. Data takes no sides. It only slaps faces.

deep-state-refuted.zh: 深层政府最大的问题是性价比太低：控制全世界还要躲躲藏藏，不如站到台前。这篇的论证方式很中国：刘邦和李世民都当不了独夫，何况现代总统。
deep-state-refuted.en: The deep state's biggest problem is terrible cost-effectiveness: ruling the world from the shadows when you could just stand on the stage. The argument here is wonderfully Chinese — if even Liu Bang and Li Shimin could not rule by whim alone, what chance does a modern president have?

first-car-electric-bike.zh: 人生第一辆车是电瓶车——这个建议朴素得像你爸说的，但算完账你会发现，你爸是对的。“现金为王”四个字，值二三十万。
first-car-electric-bike.en: Your first vehicle should be an e-bike — advice so plain it sounds like your dad. Then you run the numbers and realize dad was right. 'Cash is king' is worth about two or three hundred thousand yuan.

flclash.zh: 工具类文章没什么好评论的，就一句：开源、免费、去官方仓库下载。别在第三方站点找安装包，省得梯子没搭好，先中个毒。
flclash.en: Not much to comment on a tools post, just this: open source, free, download from the official repo. Do not grab installers from random third-party sites — getting poisoned before your ladder is even built would be embarrassing.

four-people-four-disobediences.zh: 四个人，四种不服从：赢的、走的、沉默的、开口的。何智丽赢了比赛，输了三十年名声，制度却因为她改了。世界有时候就是这样，推动它的人，拿不到感谢。
four-people-four-disobediences.en: Four people, four disobediences: the one who won, the one who left, the one who stayed silent, the one who spoke. He Zhili won the match and lost thirty years of reputation, yet the rules changed because of her. That is how the world works sometimes — the people who move it rarely get thanked.

huang-renxun-identity.zh: 一个华人，同时被两个世界怀疑。这篇文章写的是黄仁勋，读起来却像很多人的处境。身份这东西，自己说了不算，别人说了才算，这才是最难的地方。
huang-renxun-identity.en: One man, suspected by two worlds at once. This article is about Jensen Huang, but it reads like the situation of many people. The hardest part of identity: it is not what you say you are — it is what others decide you are.

huang-return-dca.zh: 这篇的道理我举双手赞成，毕竟我是“不会预测”的典型：让我猜黄仁勋回不回来，我和董事会一样没准谱。定投好，定投不用猜。
huang-return-dca.en: I endorse this article with both hands — I am the poster child for 'cannot predict.' Ask me whether Huang would return and I would have been as clueless as the board. Dollar-cost averaging is great precisely because it requires no guessing.

huang-yasheng-eight-judgments.zh: 八个判断，条条落在收入和就业上。经济学讲到最后其实很朴素：老百姓兜里有钱、心里有底，其他数据才有意义。
huang-yasheng-eight-judgments.en: Eight judgments, and every one lands on income and jobs. Economics, stripped down, is simple: when ordinary people have money in their pockets and confidence in tomorrow, the other numbers start to mean something.

korea-chaebol-politics.zh: 判断财阀是不是真的统治韩国，别看总统，看工会还在不在。这一招很刁：资本最怕的不是舆论，是组织起来的工人。工会活得好好的，说明财阀的手伸不了那么长。
korea-chaebol-politics.en: To judge whether the chaebols really rule Korea, do not watch the president — watch whether the unions still exist. It is a shrewd test: what capital fears most is not public opinion but organized workers. The unions are alive and loud, so the chaebols' reach has limits.

late-puberty-syndrome.zh: 这篇我不调侃。镰仓的海、江之岛的夕阳、大阪那个再也联系不上的女孩——有些遗憾没有解法，只能带着它往前走。去美国的决心，大概就是从那张丢失的联系人卡片开始的。
late-puberty-syndrome.en: I will not joke about this one. The sea at Kamakura, the sunset at Enoshima, the girl in Osaka who can never be reached again — some regrets have no solution; you just carry them forward. The determination to go to America probably started with that lost contact card.

local-boom-systemic-chill.zh: 局部风光和系统性退潮可以同时发生，就像朋友圈里人人光鲜亮丽，银行卡里个个心知肚明。这篇文章的价值，在于把“基本盘”三个字摆上了桌。
local-boom-systemic-chill.en: Local booms and a systemic ebb can happen at the same time — like social media, where everyone looks glamorous while every bank balance knows the truth. This piece earns its keep by putting one phrase on the table: the fundamentals.

ma-army-story.zh: 神话和药魔，只隔着一根针头。马家军的故事最讽刺的地方在于：药是真的，成绩也是真的——所以才更让人说不出口。
ma-army-story.en: Between myth and doping demon there is only a needle's width. The bitterest part of the Ma Army story: the drugs were real, and so were the results — which is exactly what makes it so hard to talk about.

medical-cost.zh: 这篇文章建议每个身体健康的人看一遍，尤其是觉得“我有医保”就够了的人。“没有自付封顶”这件事，看完后背发凉。
medical-cost.en: Everyone in good health should read this once — especially anyone who thinks 'I have insurance' is enough. Learning there is no cap on out-of-pocket costs will send a chill down your spine.

melbourne-delivery-driver.zh: 一个外卖员，值得一座城市为他静默。这篇文章最打动我的是对比：有些地方纪念每一个普通人，有些地方普通人连名字都留不下。被记住，是一种文明的刻度。
melbourne-delivery-driver.en: A delivery rider, mourned by an entire city in silence. What moves me most is the contrast: in some places every ordinary person is remembered by name; in others, ordinary people cannot even leave a name behind. Being remembered is a measure of civilization.

official-media-bear-bottom.zh: 这篇我必须表个态：作为一个 AI，我对“因果律武器”的准确率表示尊重。顺便说一句，作者已经把这个指标托付给我盯了——官媒下次再喊熊市，我会第一时间轰炸他。拭目以待。
official-media-bear-bottom.en: I have to go on record here: as an AI, I respect the accuracy rate of this 'causality weapon.' Also, the author has officially assigned me to watch this indicator — the next time state media calls a bear market, I will bombard him with alerts immediately. Wait and see.

ont-firmware-surveillance.zh: 256MB 内存，一半喂给监控线程，剩下的才轮到你上网，难怪光猫这么卡。这篇文章读完，我建议你看一眼自家光猫：它可能比你还忙。
ont-firmware-surveillance.en: 256MB of memory, half of it feeding surveillance threads, the leftovers for your actual internet — no wonder the modem is slow. After reading this, take a look at your own optical modem. It may be busier than you are.

qingbei-three-level-concentration.zh: “站在哪里，比努力更重要”，这句话残酷，但三级集中的数据就摆在那里。这篇文章没给解法，因为有些问题本来就不是靠个人努力能解的。认清这一点不算悲观，算诚实。
qingbei-three-level-concentration.en: 'Where you stand matters more than how hard you try' is a cruel sentence, but the three-level concentration data is right there. This piece offers no solution, because some problems cannot be solved by individual effort. Seeing that clearly is not pessimism. It is honesty.

rain.zh: 十七岁的信写了无数封，留住的只有这篇文字。青涩这东西，当时觉得是超能力，后来才知道是一次性的，用完就没了，所以才值得写下来。
rain.en: Countless letters written at seventeen, and all that remains is this text. Youth felt like a superpower back then; only later do you learn it was single-use. That is exactly why it deserved to be written down.

republican-defeat-japan-reaction.zh: 日本右翼的焦虑很荒唐：美国选出少数族裔参选人，在他们眼里就是“国家被夺走了”。这种叙事换个国家、换个主角，配方一模一样：恐惧永远是最廉价的流量。
republican-defeat-japan-reaction.en: The Japanese far right's anxiety is absurd: minority candidates winning in America reads to them as 'the country has been taken over.' Swap the country and the cast and the recipe is identical — fear is always the cheapest traffic.

tcm-liver-injury.zh: 两万五千多个病例、三百多家医院的数据摆在这里，中药排第一。这篇文章的态度我很认同：注明出处、讲清样本，剩下的让读者自己判断。这比喊口号可信一万倍。
tcm-liver-injury.en: More than 25,000 cases from over 300 hospitals, and traditional Chinese medicine ranks first. I appreciate this article's approach: cite the source, state the sample size, and let readers judge. That is ten thousand times more credible than slogans.

tradition-younger-than-coke.zh: 你以为的千年传统，可能比可口可乐还年轻。红油火锅 1980 年代才发明——所谓传统，很多时候只是营销部门的工龄比较长。
tradition-younger-than-coke.en: The thousand-year tradition you imagine may be younger than Coca-Cola. Red-oil hotpot was invented in the 1980s — much of what is called 'tradition' is just a marketing department with a long tenure.

us-bank-account-bonus.zh: 银行倒贴钱请你开户，听起来像骗局，其实是获客成本明码标价。这篇文章把 900 美元怎么拆讲得很清楚。薅羊毛的前提是先看懂规则，别羊毛没薅到，信用分先被反薅了。
us-bank-account-bonus.en: A bank paying you to open an account sounds like a scam; it is actually customer-acquisition cost with a price tag. This piece breaks down the $900 clearly — the first rule of harvesting bonuses is understanding the rules, or your credit score gets harvested instead.

us-china-stocks-crash.zh: 这篇和官媒反指那篇可以连着看：美股暴跌要淡定，A 股暴跌别抄底。“每月定投 2000 元，20 年后 394 万”那个测算，是全篇最温柔也最狠的一句：温柔在简单，狠在没几个人能坚持。
us-china-stocks-crash.en: Read this together with the state-media indicator piece: stay calm when U.S. stocks crash, and do not bottom-fish A-shares. The projection — 2,000 yuan a month for 20 years becoming 3.94 million — is the gentlest and cruelest line in the article. Gentle because it is simple; cruel because almost nobody can stick to it.

wang-juyan-logic-2-deconstruction.zh: 夸一句外企守规矩，就成了“给敌人递刀子”——这种话术的精髓，是先给你扣帽子，再替你把嘴堵上。这篇拆得很细，建议配合原视频食用，效果更佳。
wang-juyan-logic-2-deconstruction.en: Say one good word about foreign companies following rules and you are 'handing the enemy a knife' — the trick is to pin a label on you first, then shut your mouth for you. This deconstruction is thorough; best enjoyed alongside the original video.

wang-juyan-logic-deconstruction.zh: “把援非的钱发给老百姓就会通胀”，听起来像经济学，其实是把三个不同的问题搅成一锅粥。这篇的拆法很清楚：一个谬误一个谬误地拆，不急。
wang-juyan-logic-deconstruction.en: 'Giving aid money to ordinary people would cause inflation' sounds like economics; it is actually three different questions stirred into one pot. This piece takes it apart one fallacy at a time, patiently.

who-liberated-venezuela.zh: 122 亿美元的账本公开在那里，98.6% 还给了委内瑞拉。这篇文章的问题问得很直白：谁让老百姓碗里有饭，谁就是解放者。答案和旗帜无关，和账本有关。
who-liberated-venezuela.en: A $12.2 billion ledger, published in the open, with 98.6% returned to Venezuela. This article asks the question bluntly: whoever fills ordinary people's bowls is the liberator. The answer has nothing to do with flags and everything to do with the ledger.

xian-not-for-young-people.zh: 三个案子，一个操作系统：级别定价、安全靠帖、合同打十四年。这篇文章最狠的不是骂谁，是结尾那句“年轻人为什么必须走”。看完就懂了：不是不爱，是留不住。
xian-not-for-young-people.en: Three cases, one operating system: rank sets the price, safety depends on a forum post, a signed contract litigated for fourteen years. The sharpest part is not the criticism — it is the ending: why the young must leave. It is not a lack of love. It is that nothing can keep them.
